what: The proposed Python redactor only specifies redact(text: str), but the current contract includes stateful streaming PEM redaction used by operator diagnostics and breadcrumb publication.
scenario_or_breakage: A PEM private key split across logging calls can lose the persisted in_pem state; future Python logging_util output could surface or publish key body lines that the shell path currently swallows.
suggested_fix: Add a minimal stateful streaming primitive and parity tests for complete/split/fresh-END PEM cases, or narrow the plan so this phase does not claim to replace the streaming side and logging_util cannot publish unredacted user-visible text.
